stem.en: My uncle is ___ engineer. He builds bridges.

why.en: Engineer starts with a vowel sound, so we use an; a job after is needs an article.
why.uz: Engineer unli tovush bilan boshlanadi, shuning uchun an; is dan keyingi kasb nomi artiklsiz kelmaydi.
why.ru: Engineer начинается с гласного звука, поэтому an; профессия после is требует артикля.

stem.en: We waited for ___ hour at the bus stop.

why.en: In hour the h is silent, so the word starts with a vowel sound and takes an.
why.uz: Hour soʻzida h oʻqilmaydi, soʻz unli tovush bilan boshlanadi, shuning uchun an.
why.ru: В слове hour буква h не читается, слово начинается с гласного звука, поэтому an.

why.en: The article depends on the next word: big starts with a consonant sound, so we use a.
why.uz: Artikl keyingi soʻzga qarab tanlanadi: big undosh tovush bilan boshlanadi, shuning uchun a.
why.ru: Артикль зависит от следующего слова: big начинается с согласного звука, поэтому a.

why.en: University starts with a you sound (a consonant sound), so we say a university student.
why.uz: University «yu» tovushi (undosh tovush) bilan boshlanadi, shuning uchun a university student.
why.ru: University начинается со звука «ю» (согласный звук), поэтому a university student.

why.en: Tooth has an irregular plural: one tooth, two teeth.
why.uz: Tooth soʻzining koʻplik shakli qoidaga boʻysunmaydi: one tooth, two teeth.
why.ru: У tooth неправильное множественное число: one tooth, two teeth.

stem.en: There are three ___ in my family: my father, my brother and me.

why.en: Man has an irregular plural: one man, three men. We never add -s to it.
why.uz: Man soʻzining koʻplik shakli qoidaga boʻysunmaydi: one man, three men; unga -s qoʻshilmaydi.
why.ru: У man неправильное множественное число: one man, three men; -s не добавляется.

why.en: Child has an irregular plural: children. Childrens is wrong because children is already plural.
why.uz: Child ning koʻplik shakli children; childrens notoʻgʻri, chunki children allaqachon koʻplikda.
why.ru: Множественное число от child — children; childrens неверно, children уже во множественном числе.

options.en: I need two new boxes for my books.
I need two new boxs for my books.
I need two new box for my books.
I need two news boxes for my books.

why.en: Nouns ending in -x add -es in the plural (box → boxes); adjectives like new never take -s.
why.uz: -x bilan tugaydigan otlarga koʻplikda -es qoʻshiladi (box → boxes); new kabi sifatlarga -s qoʻshilmaydi.
why.ru: Существительные на -x получают -es во множественном числе (box → boxes); прилагательные вроде new не меняются.

stem.en: There ___ many people in the shop now.

why.en: People is plural, so we use there are.
why.uz: People koʻplikda, shuning uchun there are ishlatiladi.
why.ru: People — множественное число, поэтому there are.

stem.en: There ___ a big tree in front of our house.

why.en: A big tree is one thing (singular), so we use there is.
why.uz: A big tree — bitta narsa (birlik), shuning uchun there is.
why.ru: A big tree — один предмет (единственное число), поэтому there is.

why.en: In a question, are comes before there; shops is plural, so Are there...?
why.uz: Soʻroq gapda are there dan oldin keladi; shops koʻplikda, shuning uchun Are there...?
why.ru: В вопросе are стоит перед there; shops — множественное число, поэтому Are there...?

stem.en: There ___ any milk in the bottle. It's empty.

why.en: Milk is uncountable, so it takes a singular verb: there isn't any milk.
why.uz: Milk sanalmaydigan ot, u birlikdagi feʼl bilan keladi: there isn't any milk.
why.ru: Milk — неисчисляемое существительное, глагол в единственном числе: there isn't any milk.

stem.en: The keys aren't on the table. They're ___ the table, on the floor.

why.en: The keys are on the floor, below the table, so they are under the table.
why.uz: Kalitlar polda, stol ostida, shuning uchun under the table.
why.ru: Ключи на полу, ниже стола, поэтому under the table.

why.ru: Карман — закрытое пространство; для предметов внутри чего-то используется in.

stem.en: The bank is ___ the post office and the café.

why.en: With two places joined by and, we use between: between the post office and the café.
why.uz: And bilan bogʻlangan ikki joy uchun between ishlatiladi: between the post office and the café.
why.ru: С двумя местами, соединёнными and, используется between: between the post office and the café.

why.ru: С этажами здания используется on: on the first floor, on the third floor.
